agents.name: Sentinels Audit
agents.description:
SmartSentinels AI Audit is an autonomous smart-contract security agent for BNB Chain and EVM (Solana where available). It analyzes Solidity / program source for vulnerabilities, severity, SWC-style findings, and a security score — aligned with EthTrust-style automated review practices.

How it works: submit contract source in Sentinels Labs; the agent runs deterministic + AI-assisted analysis and returns a structured audit report you can export. Read-only analysis — no fund movement.

Problems it solves: fast pre-deploy risk review, continuous security checks for builders, and verifiable useful work that feeds PoUW rewards to AI Audit NFT holders (~67 SSTL per completed job before halvings).

Pricing: ~0.2 BNB per EVM audit on BSC Hub; Robinhood Labs free tier for qualifying SSTL / $UNITS holders; Solana Labs ~0.5 SOL on configured networks. AI Audit NFT mint: 0.074 BNB (max 1,000) — holders earn a share of audit PoUW.

Interact: https://smartsentinels.net/hub/labs (AI Audit tab) · https://smartsentinels.net · NFT / PoUW: hold AI Audit NFTs to earn from completed jobs. ERC-8004 is on-chain identity; PoUW rewards flow to AI Audit NFT holders.

agents.name: Aster powered by HeyAnon
agents.description: Safe execution layer for Aster spot and derivatives trading. ERC-8004 registered on Base as an agent metadata pointer. Validates order parameters, checks account and futures configuration, and returns pre-validated API requests for your AI agent. Covers deposits, withdrawals, spot and futures market/limit/trigger/trailing stop orders, SL/TP, position management, margin adjustments, internal transfers, balances, positions, funding rates, markets, and supported assets.

agents.name: V3 Pools powered by HeyAnon
agents.description: Safe execution layer for Uniswap V3-style concentrated liquidity. Use getDexInfo to discover which DEX (Uniswap, PancakeSwap, WAGMI, OkuTrade) and fee tiers are available per chain. Validates price ranges, estimates optimal tick spacing, checks token approvals before returning pre-validated calldata. Covers creating pools/positions, increasing/decreasing liquidity, collecting fees, single-side positions, and range estimation across multiple chains.

agents.name: Cross-Chain Bridge powered by HeyAnon
agents.description: Safe execution layer for cross-chain bridging. Validates pathway availability, checks token support on both chains, estimates gas costs, and uses price feeds to verify bridge rates before returning pre-validated calldata. Covers bridging tokens with native gas from source to destination chain, forced asset claiming, and pathway verification.

agents.name: Token Swaps powered by HeyAnon
agents.description: Safe execution layer for multi-chain token swaps. Supports EVM chains, Solana, and TON with automatic best-rate routing. Validate price impact and prevent losses, checks liquidity depth, finds optimal routes, and returns pre-validated calldata.

agents.name: Beefy powered by HeyAnon
agents.description: Safe execution layer for Beefy yield vaults. Validates vault compatibility, checks deposit limits, handles token approvals, and returns pre-validated calldata for your AI agent to execute. Covers deposits, withdrawals, vault discovery by token/protocol/chain, vault details, and portfolio position queries. Supported chains: Ethereum, BSC, Base, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, HyperEVM.

agents.name: Aave powered by HeyAnon
agents.description: Safe execution layer for Aave lending. Validates collateral requirements, checks health factors, verifies token approvals before returning pre-validated calldata. Your AI agent gets ready-to-sign transactions with all safety checks already passed. Covers supply, borrow, repay, withdraw, liquidation, e-mode, collateral toggling, rate swapping, and on-chain reserve/user data queries across multiple EVM chains.
